name: Doula

pf.license.need: optional, and never verified by Rosie: a doula may add a certification or training certificate it holds; Rosie looks nothing up and never says anything is checked
pf.license.who: the business says what it holds; the owner adds each person's own number on the secure page
pf.license.ask: each person's certificate number, if they hold one, in their invite reply (or the owner sends it)
pf.license.check: none: nothing is looked up; Rosie never says a certificate was checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks: the business's own word only: if the owner says a job needs a certificate a person doesn't have, that person isn't offered for it
pf.license.video: a video session counts as at the office; no license is needed for it beyond the owner's word
pf.license.away: home visits only for the doulas the owner clears for home visits
pf.license.lactation: none: breastfeeding help is a lactation consultant's own work (another business)
pf.license.vaccines: none: no shot or vaccine orders are taken through Rosie
pf.license.agreement: a privacy agreement signed on the secure page before the first booking, where the family's health details are kept; every company in Rosie's chain signs one with Rosie
pf.license.renewals: none: Rosie keeps no renewal dates; the owner can note one by hand
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance, if the owner adds it: a note only, never checked
pf.license.claims: 'certified' or 'trained' is shown only where the owner says so; never as checked

pf.services.shape: support for the family through pregnancy, birth and the weeks after: prenatal sessions at the office or by video, birth support on call from about 37 weeks, and postpartum visits at home; sessions are booked one at a time, the next at checkout
pf.services.examples: the example business's own prices and lengths, not a standard

list.name: Meet the doula (free consult)
list.where: at the office, or by video
list.note: questions, the way the doula works, and whether the family wants a birth doula, a postpartum doula or both

list.name: Birth doula package
list.kind: one price for the whole package
list.length: about 6 weeks of support around the birth
list.where: prenatal sessions at the office or by video; the birth at the place the family chooses (the doula goes on call); postpartum visits at home
list.before: a $400 deposit when the agreement is signed
list.after: the rest is paid at the visits (office) or on the bill after the birth (home), never charged on a set day by itself
list.note: covers the prenatal sessions, being on call from 37 weeks, the birth support, and the postpartum visits in the package; a session the family adds is priced first

list.name: Prenatal session
list.where: at the office, or by video
list.note: a session on the birth plan or a question the family brings

list.name: Birth prep session
list.where: at the office, or by video
list.note: a session for the two people who will be at the birth

list.name: Postpartum visit at home (3 hours)
list.after: the bill comes after DONE (a link to pay)
list.note: help with feeding, sleep, the house and the older children; the doula does not give medical care

pf.services.capacity: each doula takes a set number of families due in one month (the business's own cap, example 4); every birth has one doula on call, with a backup doula the family has met
pf.services.onCall: from about 37 weeks to the birth, the family's doula is on call for them at any hour; the family uses the business's on-call line (pf.safety) when labor starts or anything worries them. Rosie gives the number and books nothing for it
pf.services.online: a prenatal session by video; it counts as at the office
pf.services.nobodyHome: never for a visit: the family must be there; a visit where nobody answers gets a safety check first (the welfare switch)
pf.services.walkIns: no walk-ins; a family in labor or with a worry uses the on-call line at any hour

beforeTimes: the first name of the person booking
a new family or a current one
which visit: the business's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
where the visit is: at the office, by video, or at home (home visits only inside the business's area)
how the family will pay: the package deposit, or pay for the visit itself
afterTime: anything the doula should know to help, like needing an interpreter
the family's name and mobile (for texts)
securePage: the birth plan and the place the family plans to give birth
the health history and the care team's names
the consents and the privacy notice
the agreement (signed on the secure page)
who else may attend, with the family's signed OK
pf.questions.whoMayBook: the family, or a partner or support person the family names on the secure page; a child under 13 never books, and nothing about them is kept
pf.questions.whoMayBring: the family, or a support person the family names with a signed OK on the secure page
pf.questions.neverAsked: symptoms, medical questions, pregnancy weeks, tests and results are never asked or typed in the AI chat

stop.words: heavy bleeding, a seizure, trouble breathing, chest pain, a fall or a car crash, or a baby who isn't breathing
stop.say: Call 911 now. Rosie can't book support for an emergency. Then call the family's own doctor or midwife, and the business's on-call line: (555) 010-0199.
stop.booking: no booking; any visit stays booked

stop.words: labor, your water breaking, or a worry about the baby
stop.say: Call your midwife or doctor now, and the business's on-call line: (555) 010-0199. If you can't reach them, or it's an emergency, call 911.
stop.booking: no booking; the on-call line answers at any hour, and Rosie books or moves nothing for it

stop.words: thoughts of harming yourself or the baby, or a crisis after the birth
stop.say: Call or text 988 now. If you are in danger, call 911. Your doula is told.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words in a later text get 988 again

stop.say: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222. If the person isn't breathing or won't wake up, call 911.

nurseLine.words: the family's own provider's list of signs that need a call (the example list includes a fever after the birth)
nurseLine.say: Please call your midwife or doctor now. If it's an emergency, call 911.
nurseLine.booking: no booking by Rosie until the family has talked with their provider

goOn.words: a worry with nothing on the lists above
goOn.where: matched to the business's own visit: Rosie never judges how serious it is

pf.safety.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: The intake, the birth plan and the agreement
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due before the first session; one reminder before it's due
steps.result: not done by its due date: the doula keeps the session (signed on the secure page first), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: A written price estimate for a session paid by the family
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day
steps.who: every family paying for a session itself
steps.result: a to-do for the office, with its due date

steps.name: The owner's OK for a new family
steps.when: before the first session is booked
steps.result: OK: booked; no: told kindly, nothing kept

pf.first_steps.prep: arrive 10 minutes early; bring the questions and any notes from the care team; a support person comes only with the family's signed OK on the secure page; at home: a clear space for the doula's supplies

pf.visit.checkIn: at the office: the check-in code at the front desk; by video: the code read out at the start; at home: the code from the family at the door
pf.visit.beforeWork: the doula checks in with the family on how they feel and what they want from the visit, before the work starts
pf.visit.changes: the doula adds a longer visit or an extra hour only with the family's yes, with any price first
pf.visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the doula's notes stay with the doula, never in Rosie or a text; the next session is booked at checkout
pf.visit.away: at home: the doula brings her own supplies; a grown-up is there for the whole visit
pf.visit.childLeft: never: an adult who brought a child to a visit stays for the whole visit

pf.money.before: nothing taken at booking for a free consult; a birth doula package takes its $400 deposit when the agreement is signed, and the rest is paid at the visits (office) or on the bill after the birth (home), never charged on a set day by itself; a session paid in full (a birth prep session, an overnight) is paid when booking
pf.money.plans: none: the doula takes no health plan
pf.money.selfPay: a family paying for a session itself is told while booking what it costs, and sees the price before the yes
pf.money.fees: no missed-visit fee by default; the owner may set one for sessions only, and it is never more than the deposit or the money paid now
pf.money.feeFree: a switch: no fee ever for a family the owner marks fee-free; their texts say 'No fee to cancel or miss'
pf.money.after: at the office: the rest is paid at the visit; at home: the bill comes after the birth, by a link; a balance is billed by the business, not by a Rosie text on a set day
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state's rules, where they set one
pf.money.rosfield: the $2 per booking applies, as for every kind of work (D97): a flat fee for each booking Rosie's AI makes; no memberships are sold here
pf.money.payOverTime: none: no package is charged on set days by itself; the rest is paid at a visit or on a bill the family gets and pays

pf.messages.never: texts carry only the business's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the pregnancy, the birth plan, symptoms or results (at a home visit the doula's name stays, for the door check)
pf.messages.staff: texts to the owner and staff carry the family's initials, the time and a link; never the visit type or any health detail
pf.messages.languages: English and Spanish; the secure page asks if the family needs an interpreter, and the business is told
pf.messages.minors: texts go to the family, or to the person the family names on the secure page; nothing about a child is texted to anyone but a parent or guardian
pf.messages.medical: a medical question is never answered, saved or passed on: 911 if it's an emergency, then the family's own provider

pf.staff.licenses: each doula's own certificate, if the owner adds it (optional; never checked by Rosie)
pf.staff.skills: birth doulas: prenatal sessions, birth support on call from about 37 weeks, and birth prep sessions; postpartum doulas: postpartum visits and overnight support at home; only people the owner clears go to homes
pf.staff.supervision: a doula in training works with an experienced doula, as the owner says (the owner's note, not checked)
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs a new family's first session, and any visit a doula flags
pf.staff.standIn: a doula out: the backup doula the family has met may take the visit, with the family's yes; nobody is moved without it
pf.staff.away: the home team is the doulas the owner clears for home visits

pf.rules.records: the doula's notes are kept as the owner's rules say; a delete request removes only Rosie's own booking details, never the notes
pf.rules.copies: a family's copy of its records within the time the rules set; Rosie sends only booking and payment records
pf.rules.showLicense: any certificate the owner adds is shown where the owner says so; Rosie shows nothing as checked
pf.rules.minors: a minor's booking follows the owner's rule; until it's set, a parent or guardian books
pf.rules.custody: a court order or custody limit the family gives the business is kept on its record, and Rosie follows the record, not the caller's word alone
pf.rules.language: free language help where the rules require it
pf.rules.host: none: no group or school hosting
pf.rules.ads: no claims about medical outcomes; no price or free-visit claims the state's rules don't allow
pf.rules.privacy: health privacy rules for every message and form

pf.edges.lateArrival: up to 15 minutes late: still seen; later, the office may offer a new time (the business decides; Rosie never changes the booking itself)
pf.edges.officeLate: when the doula runs late, a new time costs nothing
pf.edges.standIn: a doula out: the backup doula the family has met, with the family's yes, or new times with no fee
pf.edges.forms: a form not done by its due date: one reminder, then the business keeps the session (signed on the secure page first), moves it, or cancels with no fee
pf.edges.twoBookings: a family with sessions open for two people: Rosie asks which one before any change
pf.edges.worse: a family worried before a visit: the 911 or on-call words if they match; Rosie never judges how serious it is, and the visit stays booked
pf.edges.healthQuestion: a question about medicine or care: never answered by Rosie or the doula; 911 if it's an emergency, then the family's own provider
pf.edges.siblings: a second person added to a booking gets their own time
pf.edges.newborn: a home visit that can't happen as booked: the soonest open window comes first, with no fee
pf.edges.urgent: no service is sent now through Rosie: labor is on call through the business's on-call line (pf.safety), and a family with a worry gets the soonest visit
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way

K8 build (Oct 27 2026, REDESIGN 2 frozen master, prof-new + ADDENDUM + Haiku notes D96/D97). From: pediatrician (refit R04, clinic with home visits); the midwife build's shared sign-up ops and license words (D96, D97); the doula's own plug-in: birth doula package, prenatal sessions, birth prep sessions, postpartum visits and overnight support at home. Birth doulas are not medical providers: labor, water breaking and worries go to the family's midwife or doctor and the business's on-call line (pf.safety), 911 for emergencies; no medical advice is given.
D96: certificates are optional and never verified; pf.license says nothing is looked up; the license words on the lit sign-up and staff steps are the owner's word (the same pairs as the midwife build); S2-11's lookup branches are off; S2-29 stays lit with words; S12-19 (lookup down) is off. The master's own license-check steps are a master change (MASTER lines).
D97: the $2 applies. S1-62's 'No $2' branch is off in both flows; no2 is never switched on; pf.money.rosfield says the $2 applies.
Money A (the office): main list|deposit|counter (the birth doula package, example $1,800: a $400 deposit when the agreement is signed, the rest paid at the visits, never on a set day by itself); list|none|none (the free consult); list|none|counter (a prenatal session, $95, paid at the visit); list|full|none (a birth prep session for two, $85, paid in full when booking).
Money B (the home): main list|deposit|bill (the home birth doula package: a $400 deposit, the rest on the bill after the birth); list|none|bill (a postpartum visit at home, 3 hours, $210, the bill after the visit); list|full|none (overnight support at home, $480, paid in full when booking).
The fee on the deposit paths is the $400 deposit kept if the family cancels by the agreement (fee never more than what was paid now). No missed-visit fee by default. No plan billing (no planbill fact), no classes, no groups, no stages, no holds.
Switches: sensitive (health and pregnancy: no rating, initials-only texts; A10-34 and B10-32 yes-rating branches off) and welfare (a family may be unable to answer during labor or after a birth: a safety check before any no-show words). no2: never on.
Facts: children, documents, extrawork, firststeps, forms, video. Not listed: classes (S1-82 'Yes' off in both flows), groups, planbill, plans, sentnow (S2-30 'Yes' off: labor is on call through the on-call line), stages, results, spaces, dropoff.
Names: Sam Lee owns Lee Birth Support LLC (flow A: the office, 52 Harbor Rd) and Lee Home Support LLC (flow B: home visits, 610 Main St). Alex M. is the client. Staff: Mara and Wren (birth doulas) at the office; Esme (birth doula) and Dara (postpartum doula) at home.
Splits decided: S1-60 and S2-28 kept (both license branches, no lookup); A8-02 kept (all here, or something missing); S1-82 off in both flows; S1-80 spaces off; S1-62 'No $2' off; S2-30 'Yes sent now' off; A4-66, A8-53, A8-67, A10-05, A10-44, A10-45, A4-43, A4-80 off (A); B8-03, B4-16, B6-03, B7-55, B8-58, B8-67, B4-83 (set start, stay, seat), B4-43, B9-19, B9-06, B10-37, B10-38, B4-92, B8-68 off (B).
Not sure (for the verifier): (1) the package's rest is paid at the visits (A) or on the bill after the birth (B), not in installments: the schedule is a gap shared with the midwife; (2) the on-call line (555) 010-0199 is an example number; labor gives the line now (pf.safety), but nothing rings the on-call doula (the midwife's gap 'On call for a client already in care' applies here too); (3) the doula's words on medical care are plain: no medical advice, a worry goes to the family's provider; (4) the price-change and example pairs are the doula's own; a reader should check the B8-19 labor-support line; (5) the master's S11-99 / S13-41 / S13-43 license-recheck wording reads as a master rule in places (MASTER).
MASTER: the same D96 and D97 master lines as the midwife build (see log new-K8.md).
Texts: sensitive work, so visit types and service names are generic words in every text (a visit, a session, care); the business name and the time stay. The midwife, doula and consultant roles are shown as roles only.
